slides.headline: He led a database company for less than a year. Then Mark Zuckerberg created a role for him at Meta - reporting directly to him.
Chirantan 'CJ' Desai stepped down as President and CEO of MongoDB on September 28, 2026, to join Meta
slides.body: Meta named him Chief Enterprise Platform Officer, a newly created role heading a division focused on turning Meta's AI capabilities into products for developers and businesses. Desai reports directly to CEO Mark Zuckerberg.

slides.eyebrow: What he actually built before this
slides.headline: He grew one company's revenue from $1.5 billion to over $10 billion - then did it again elsewhere.
slides.body: Before MongoDB, Desai spent nearly 8 years at ServiceNow, rising to President and COO and overseeing growth from $1.5 billion to over $10 billion in annualized revenue. He later led Product & Engineering at Cloudflare before taking the MongoDB CEO role in November 2025.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: One of the world's largest tech companies just built an entire new division around one executive's track record.
slides.body: A Viksit Bharat by 2047 needs its technical leaders trusted with exactly this kind of authority - not just running a team, but defining what a company's next division even looks like.
